description: This file defines the LeavePeriodDefinedHomePageEnabler class, which implements logic to determine whether the leave period is defined for a user within the OrangeHRM system, guiding navigation redirection based on leave configuration status.

classes.name: LeavePeriodDefinedHomePageEnabler
classes.description: A class that checks if the leave period is undefined and determines if certain home page features should be enabled based on leave configuration.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the leave period is not defined and returns true if it isn't, thus enabling navigation to the leave period setup page.
